policy.organizeBy: CEFR first, then GLEAS placement ladder
policy.originalPassagesWrittenFor: GLEAS L1–L6 / CEFR Pre-A1–B2 placement reading

Little Critter.cefrNote: Below A1: very short sentences, high picture dependence, basic daily vocab.

Fly Guy.cefrNote: A1 or below: short repeated structures, simple narrative.

Nate the Great.cefrNote: Mystery chapter books; higher than pure A2, up to early B1. Calibrates L3 only.

My Weird School.cefrNote: Funny school chapters; denser than early A2, up to B1 possible. Calibrates L3 only.
